channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Bay Ferry Landing
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay Ferry Landing (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: The ferry landing now sits at its designed position, with the separate water taxi landing the City reviews with it as one project. Both follow the City's 2018 plan, not as-built drawings, and nothing was built there in the August 2025 imagery. The outline is still approximate.
item.description: The ferry landing now sits at its designed position, with the separate water taxi landing the City reviews with it as one project. Both follow the City's 2018 plan, not as-built drawings, and nothing was built there in the August 2025 imagery. The outline is still approximate. Source: San Francisco Planning Department, Final Mitigated Negative Declaration, Case No. 2017-008824ENV (2018).
item.source: San Francisco Planning Department, Final Mitigated Negative Declaration, Case No. 2017-008824ENV (2018)

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: This page said no source places the ferry landing at the former Pier 64. The City's 2018 environmental review does: it says the project area is at Pier 64, called "Pier 64½" in the Port's Waterfront Land Use Plan documents.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: The City's environmental review names two Assessor lots for the ferry landing project, 9900064 and 9900064H. This record had said no lot exists. The landings drawn on the map are the 2018 design and mostly lie outside those lots' outlines, so the map is unchanged.

The landings drawn on the map are the 2018 design and mostly lie outside those lots' outlines, so the map is unchanged. Source: San Francisco Planning Department, Final Mitigated Negative Declaration, Case No. 2017-008824ENV, cover page; DataSF, Parcels - Active and Retired (acdm-wktn), the rows for Assessor lots 9900064 and 9900064H, queried 2026-10-10.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: The April 2026 transportation sales-tax funding for the ferry landing was shown as $9.8 million. That figure covers three projects; SFCTA's own post gives the ferry landing $4.5 million, toward a $77.1 million project.
item.description: The April 2026 transportation sales-tax funding for the ferry landing was shown as $9.8 million. That figure covers three projects; SFCTA's own post gives the ferry landing $4.5 million, toward a $77.1 million project. Source: https://www.sfcta.org/blogs/98-million-sales-tax-funds-approved-support-downtown-revitalization-caltrain-station-ada.

item.title: Added · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: New nearby-project record for the WETA/Port Mission Bay Ferry Landing, near Agua Vista Park on Terry A. Francois Blvd, targeted for completion by the end of 2027, with SFCTA approving further Prop L sales-tax funding toward it in April 2026.
item.description: New nearby-project record for the WETA/Port Mission Bay Ferry Landing, near Agua Vista Park on Terry A. Francois Blvd, targeted for completion by the end of 2027, with SFCTA approving further Prop L sales-tax funding toward it in April 2026. Source: Port of San Francisco, Mission Bay Ferry Landing (https://www.sfport.com/projects-programs/mission-bay-ferry-landing); San Francisco County Transportation Authority, 2026-04 (https://www.sfcta.org/blogs/98-million-sales-tax-funds-approved-support-downtown-revitalization-caltrain-station-ada).

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: SFCTA Board approves $4.5M in Prop L sales-tax funds toward the $77.1M Mission Bay Ferry Landing (its share of $9.8M approved for three projects; approved April 14, final approval April 28, 2026). (Apr 2026)
item.description: SFCTA Board approves $4.5M in Prop L sales-tax funds toward the $77.1M Mission Bay Ferry Landing (its share of $9.8M approved for three projects; approved April 14, final approval April 28, 2026). (Apr 2026). Source: San Francisco County Transportation Authority, 2026-04.

item.title: Expected · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: Completion of the ferry landing is expected by the end of 2027. (~2027)

item.title: Complete · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: Phase 2a marine demolition (removal of derelict piles at the site) reported complete. (~2025)
